tm.「申し訳ありません。\n この先への立ち入りは ご遠慮ください。: "I'm sorry. Please refrain from entering beyond this point.
tm.「中央の階段を上って ２階の西側にある\n 貴賓室に 勇者さまのベッドが ござい: "Up the central stairs, the second floor's west guest room has the Luminary's bed. Use it whenever you're sleepy.
tm.「……待て。どこへ向かうつもりだ？\n 一刻も早く 玉座の間に向かい\n 常闇を: "...Wait. Where are you heading? Let's go to the throne room at once and defeat the monster that creates eternal darkness.
tm.「デルカダール城下町は 崩壊が激しく\n 歩いてまわるのは 危険だ。\n 外には: "Heliodor's castle town is badly ruined and dangerous to walk around. Better not go outside.
tm.我らがデルカダール王と グレイグ将軍が\n遠征より 無事に ご帰還: Our King of Heliodor and General Hendrik have returned safely from the expedition.
tm.勇者{var:1}は 悪魔の子にあらず\nデルカダール王国と 王を救いし者として: The Luminary {var:1} is no devil's child! Praise the name of the one who saved Heliodor and its king!
tm.「おお 勇者 {var:1}さま。\n 申し訳ありませんが 今は 遅い時間ですか: "Oh, Luminary {var:1}. I'm sorry, but it's late now. Please come again in the morning.
tm.「お待ちください。勇者さまは\n 王より 使命を言い渡されたはず。\n さあ デ: "Please wait. The King has given the Luminary a mission. Please head to the Emerald Coast.
tm.「ハハ ずいぶんと お疲れみたいだな。\n ま あんなに豪華な席で もてなされる: "Ha, you look pretty tired. Well, being treated at such a lavish table for the first time, no wonder.
tm.「もう 夜も遅いし 休んできたらどうだ？\n ２階の 西にある貴賓室に\n お前: "It's late; why not go rest? Your bed is apparently ready in the guest room on the second floor's west side.
tm.「ねえ {var:1}。\n あたしたちは アンタを 命の大樹まで\n 送り届け: "Hey, {var:1}. Our mission was to see you safely to Yggdrasil, but...
tm.「まだ ウルノーガを倒したわけじゃないし\n こんなハンパな形で 別れるつもりは: "We haven't beaten Mordegon yet, and I won't part ways in such a half-baked way. Count on me from here on.
tm.「まあ {var:1}さま。\n 今 はじめて {var:1}さまに\n お会い: "Oh, {var:1}. I was just recounting my memories of when I first met you.
tm.「なんだか 不思議ですわね……。\n {var:1}さまとは もっと もっと昔に: "Strange, isn't it... I feel I've met you in a much, much earlier time too.
tm.「あら {var:1}ちゃん！\n デルカダール城の人たちは ノリがいいわね！\: "Oh, {var:1}! The Heliodor Castle folk are fun! They're keeping me entertained♪
tm.「ウフフッ よかったら {var:1}ちゃんも\n 一曲 踊っていったらどう？\: "Hehe, if you like, why not dance a song too, {var:1}? At times like this, don't be shy!
tm.「私は １６年ぶりに お父さまと会えたのに\n なんだか 話しづらくて……。\n: "I met Father for the first time in sixteen years, and yet it feels hard to talk to him... Will it get easier with time?
tm.「……ごめんなさい 変なことを言って。\n そこの部屋に あなたのベッドを用意さ: "...Sorry, I said something odd. I had your bed prepared in that room, so please use it if you like.
tm.「……まだ おぬしが生まれる前\n デルカダール城に おもむいた時に\n 幼い頃: "...Before you were born, when I visited Heliodor Castle, I saw Jasper as a little boy.
tm.「あの時は 純粋そうな子だと思ったものじゃが\n どんな魔物に そそのかされて\: "He seemed so pure then. What monster could have tempted him to stray from the path of humanity...
